One who has fear of heaven IS the yirah domain — the person embodies yirah, the essential quality of Package 3.

Rinah (joyful song) IS tefillah — 'rinah leshon tefillah' — and the mountains/tzaddikim sing it after the thunder. The harim (already in Package 4) yranenu in joy. Rinah belongs in the prayer-voice domain.
Ra'am (thunder, singular) IS re'amim — the essential thunder of the gevurot domain.
From the side of Isaac IS the yirah domain — Isaac = gevurah = yirah in Kabbalistic mapping. The text says 'ra'am mi-sitra de-Yitzchak'. Isaac's essential nature is the fear/gevurah of Package 3.
The voice being imprinted on the heart IS the thunder reaching its target — 'tevel = tav-lev = reshimah in the heart'. This is the thunder's inscription.

The essential empowerment of the gevurot IS the gevurot domain — it describes how the divine powers are strengthened.
Love coming of its own accord IS the ahavah-yirah pairing — the husband seeking the wife. Ahavah is already in Package 3. This describes their reunion.

connected_to: תדע, שזה משמיעין אותך תוכחה, על שפגמת בטפי מחך

assignments.reason: Rebuke for blemishing brain-drops IS about the mochin — the tipei mocha (brain drops) that descend from the intellect. Its essential nature is the mochin domain.
Prayer IS the voice — the kol she-adam motzi be-koach bi-tfilato. Prayer is the vehicle of the thunder mechanism, the harim yeranenu. Its nature is the prayer-voice-thunder domain.
Overcoming your enemies IS the power of the gevurot — 'shev limini ad ashit oyvekha'. Victory through the thunder-powers is the gevurot in their martial expression.
